basics.name: Qian Cheng
basics.summary: I use AI agents to write formal specifications, check concurrent and distributed systems for bugs, and prove properties of those systems with TLA+.
basics.label: PhD Student in Computer Science, researching formal methods on real-world systems

education.area: Ph.D. in Computer Science and Technology
B.S. in Computer Science and Technology

publications.name: TLAPS-Bench: Formally Proving Correctness of Real-World System Specifications with TLA+ Proof System
publications.summary: A benchmark and execution harness for AI agents that construct machine-checked proofs of real-world TLA+ specifications.

publications.name: Specula: Scaling Formal Specifications for Autonomous Model Checking of System Code
publications.summary: An agentic system that generates and validates TLA+ specifications, finds deep bugs through model checking, and reproduces them in system code.

publications.name: Research Progress on Distributed System Model Checking Technologies
publications.summary: This paper provides a comprehensive survey of research progress in distributed system model checking.

publications.name: SysMoBench: Evaluating AI on Formally Specifying Complex Real-World Systems
publications.summary: A benchmark suite for evaluating AI capabilities on formally modeling complex real-world systems.

presentations.name: Specula: Generating TLA+ Specifications from System Code Using Generative AI
presentations.description: An introduction to Specula and its approach to generating TLA+ specifications from real system code using generative AI.

portfolio.name: Specular
portfolio.description: Specular (formerly Specula) generates TLA+ specifications from system code, checks them for bugs, and reproduces the findings in the implementation.
